display_information.name: Morgenruf
display_information.description: Async daily standups in Slack: private DMs, one clean channel summary, AI summaries and analytics. Hosted or self-hosted.
display_information.long_description:
Morgenruf runs your team's daily standups in Slack. At the time you choose, it DMs each person your standup questions, then posts one tidy summary to your channel, with an optional AI summary (OpenAI or Anthropic).

Key features:
• AI standup summaries
• Dashboard with participation charts
• Several standups per workspace
• Each person's own timezone
• Skip a day, edit your answers, mood check-in
• Kudos with a leaderboard
• Coffee chats, birthdays and work anniversaries
• Jira, GitHub and Linear issue links
• Webhooks
• MCP server: connect Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to your standup data
• Admin roles
• Weekly digest emails
• Use the hosted version at morgenruf.dev, or self-host on Kubernetes, Docker Compose or AWS

MIT licensed and free forever.

Docs: https://docs.morgenruf.dev
